description: Nominate another avatar for mayor. Prerequisite: active election_cycle in state='nomination'; caller must be a resident of the target neighborhood and not have moved in <30 days (Election_Move_Penalty; admins bypass). Target must be a resident of same neighborhood and also pass move-date check. Effect: fso_election_votes row INSERT (type='nomination'); if target reaches Min_Nominations (default 3), also creates an fso_election_candidates row in state='informed' and mails the candidate an AcceptNomination invite (see accept-candidacy op). Returns SUCCESS. Refuse paths: ELECTION_OVER, BAD_STATE (wrong cycle state), NOT_IN_NHOOD, CANDIDATE_NOT_IN_NHOOD, ALREADY_VOTED (already nominated once), YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY, CANDIDATE_MOVED_RECENTLY, INVALID_AVATAR. On workshop's current DB (no active cycle), nominate refuses deterministically with ELECTION_OVER — this is the test's expected wire-level effect. Wire: NhoodRequest{Type=NOMINATE, TargetAvatar, TargetNHood} on city Aries; resolves on the next NhoodResponse.

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: Hex or decimal persist_id of the avatar to nominate. Mutually exclusive with target_avatar_name — if both are supplied, target_avatar_name takes precedence (I0-5 name-primary invariant).

args.name: target_avatar_name
args.description: Name-store binding of the avatar to nominate (kind=sim). Resolved to target_persist_id via the sidecar naming store. Takes precedence over target_persist_id when both are supplied. Preferred call shape per I0-5 name-primary invariant.

call_signatures: cf $CF nominate --target_avatar_name <name>                                                                      # preferred: resolve name from store (kind=sim); defaults neighborhood_id=1

cf $CF nominate --target_persist_id <candidate_persist_id>                                                      # fallback: hex/decimal persist_id; defaults neighborhood_id=1; same ELECTION_OVER refuse on workshop
common_mistakes: target_avatar_name not bound in name store (or bound with wrong kind) → ok:false with name-resolution error.
target_persist_id = 0 or missing (and no target_avatar_name) → ok:false.
Same ELECTION_OVER / YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY server-side refuses as vote.
perception_hints: Neighborhood id (defaults to 1 on workshop): perception.lot.lot_id is a lot id, not a nhood id — most ops default nhood_id to 1
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-vote/self-nominate): perception.avatar.persist_id
Your lot membership (residency gate): perception.lot.owner_is_me or check is_roommate via query-lot
refuse_conditions: target_avatar_name present but not bound in name store → ok:false with name-resolution error
target_avatar_name bound with kind != sim → ok:false (name must be a sim binding)
neither target_avatar_name nor target_persist_id provided → ok:false
target resolves to own avatar_id → ok:false (self-nominate rejected by server)
server NHOOD_NO_ELECTION / ELECTION_OVER / NOT_IN_NHOOD / YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY → ok:false with code
